### ReloadSource

```ts
type ReloadSource = Readonly<object &
  | {
  effect: "now";
  reload: (signal) => Promise<void>;
}
  | {
  effect: "next_turn";
}
  | {
  effect: "unsupported";
  reason: string;
}>;
```

One category a host can account for in `/reload`, described by the owner that
already holds it. Nothing here caches, restarts or replaces anything: `now`
re-reads through the owner's own refresh, `next_turn` names a source the owner
already re-reads at the start of every turn, and `unsupported` names a category
with no safe re-read or replace lifecycle today.

### runSlashDraft()

```ts
function runSlashDraft(
  draft,
  commands,
  send,
  origin,
  consumeDraft?,
): Promise<WhistleExecutionOutcome | undefined>;
```

Run one composer draft: a prompt goes to `send`, a `/command` runs through
Whistle. A grammar that asks for a request id keeps the same id across retries
of the same draft until the command is handled. A slash projection can request
draft consumption before dispatch, including while a dialog is open.

#### Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                            |
| --------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `draft`         | `string`                        |
| `commands`      | [`SlashRuntime`](#slashruntime) |
| `send`          | () => `void`                    |
| `origin`        | `WhistleExecutionOrigin`        |
| `consumeDraft?` | () => `void`                    |

#### Returns

`Promise`\<`WhistleExecutionOutcome` \| `undefined`\>

### useApprovalAwaiting()

```ts
function useApprovalAwaiting(options): void;
```

Put one source's pending approval in the composer's queue. While the record is
answerable and the person is present it asks through decision prompts; a changed
revision replaces the item, so only the record on screen can be answered. Esc
postpones it: the record stays pending in the ledger.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options` | `Readonly`\<\{ `source`: [`ApprovalSource`](#approvalsource) \| `undefined`; `store`: [`ParakeetInteractions`](#parakeetinteractions); `enabled`: `boolean`; `home`: `string`; `width`: `number`; `noteLimit`: `number`; `onFailure`: (`cause`) => `void`; \}\> |

#### Returns

`void`

---

### useDecision()

```ts
function useDecision(item, context): DecisionController;
```

Own the answering of one waiting decision for any renderer: the reducer's state
per prompt, the answer sent to the item's host, and the refusal that comes back.
Renderers draw `view` and forward intents, nothing else.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                                                |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `item`    | [`AwaitingItem`](#awaitingitem)                                                     |
| `context` | `Readonly`\<\{ `position`: `number`; `total`: `number`; `later`: () => `void`; \}\> |

#### Returns

[`DecisionController`](#decisioncontroller)
